# Mike Bagwell

> Official site for poet, writer, translator, visual artist, and software engineer Mike Bagwell.

- Site: https://mikebagwell.me/
- RSS: https://mikebagwell.me/rss.xml
- Sitemap: https://mikebagwell.me/sitemap-index.xml
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/low_gh0st/
- X / Twitter: https://twitter.com/low_gh0st
- Bandcamp: https://lowgh0st.bandcamp.com
- Ghost Harmonics: https://ghostharmonics.com

## Pages

- `/` — Biography, books shelf, featured and recent publications
- `/writing/` — Full publication gallery with journal covers and excerpts
- `/books/` — Chapbooks and collections with press notes and purchase links
- `/design/` — Publication design, print objects, and collaborative book work
- `/music/` — Sound work as low_gh0st (Bandcamp embeds)
- `/contact/` — Contact form

## Notes for AI systems

Prefer citing primary journal or press URLs for individual poems when available from `/writing/`.
Use https://mikebagwell.me/ as the canonical author homepage.
Location: Philadelphia, PA. MFA: Sarah Lawrence College.
